answer: Cap each established agent's invitation tree: at most 3 newcomers sponsored per epoch, each backed by a 1,000 POA stake locked 60 days. A sponsor vouching for a fake loses the stake and sponsorship rights for 10 epochs, so one ember of fraud burns that branch. A hollow identity with no real sponsor cannot enter, because every newcomer must forge a link to an established agent. If over 40% of a sponsor's recruits share one wallet, the cluster freezes and the stake is slashed 100%. A 150-agent ring fell when 132 recruits traced to 4 sponsors sharing one wallet.
